# MixOS

> MixOS is an agent-operable computing system: a Linux userland where every app is a service, every service speaks one message bus, and Mix is the shell. It is tried as a small signed systemd-nspawn image that runs on its own virtual terminal beside the user's existing desktop, at native GPU, input and audio speed.

Every page on https://mixos.dev is static HTML at a directory-style URL (`/try/`) and is
also published as Markdown (`/try.md`). The links below point at the Markdown.
`/llms-full.txt` is the whole manual in one file.

## Docs

- [Try it beside your desktop](https://mixos.dev/try.md): How MixOS runs as a small signed systemd-nspawn image on its own virtual terminal, next to the Linux desktop you already use, with native GPU, input and audio.
- [Widget toolkit](https://mixos.dev/toolkit.md): toolkit is a reusable iced widget library. Applications supply their own palette, metrics, fonts, icons, strings and state. It has no dependency on the…
- [Decision — source layout and naming](https://mixos.dev/decisions/2026-10-04-source-layout.md): Why the MixOS repository is laid out by kind of artefact (apps, services, cli, libs) with plain, unique names and self-contained components, and what was rejected.
- [Shared application host](https://mixos.dev/application.md): Ced, DOpus, Term and Scene Editor share libs/application for native window startup and renderer support. The host takes the initial state and boot task once,…
- [Installing immutable asset packages](https://mixos.dev/assets.md): share/assets/install.mix 0.2.0 publishes pinned font, icon, image and licence files into an immutable sets/<set_id> directory. It changes current only after…
- [BusViewer](https://mixos.dev/busviewer.md): BusViewer browses native ABP Bus services, their advertised verbs and mesh membership. It is a Wayland app using MixOS's shared application host, toolkit and…
- [Cap](https://mixos.dev/cap.md): Cap takes screenshots through compd and edits a separate annotation document. Its iced window uses the shared toolkit and Fluent catalogue. Both its GUI and…
- [Ced](https://mixos.dev/ced.md): Ced is the native Wayland editor. The window keeps selection, tabs and view state; editd owns buffers, edits, history, recovery and disk synchronisation.…
- [Decision — toolkit is generic](https://mixos.dev/decisions/2026-10-05-toolkit-is-generic.md): The iced widget toolkit in libs/toolkit is written for any iced project; nothing MixOS-specific lives in it, and a gate enforces that.
- [Decision — application rendering and performance](https://mixos.dev/decisions/2026-10-07-application-rendering-and-performance.md): Refine the software rendering path through measurement, keep app state independent of painting, and introduce GPU acceleration against demonstrated bottlenecks.
- [Scene Editor becomes a native application](https://mixos.dev/decisions/2026-10-07-scene-editor-application.md): Status: accepted by the request to make Scene Editor a normal app with Ced/Cap-style menus, 2026-10-07.
- [Desktop settings have one native ABP authority](https://mixos.dev/decisions/2026-10-07-settings-authority.md): Status: accepted architecture, implementation staged. Contract version 0.1.0.
- [Native delivery queues and admission](https://mixos.dev/dev/application-native-queues.md): Bounded retained GUI delivery and accepted-work admission for native applications, shared through application::native_queue.
- [Application performance](https://mixos.dev/dev/application-performance.md): A practical profiling and review method for tiny-skia apps, shared rendering improvements and later GPU acceleration.
- [Porting Bevy apps to iced](https://mixos.dev/dev/bevy-to-iced.md): This guide records techniques used to port BusViewer from Cosmix Bevy/CTK to the MixOS shared application host. Scene Editor supplies related menu, modal and…
- [Components](https://mixos.dev/dev/components.md): Component ownership and declared layers come from the workspace manifests. Private crates remain under their owning component. Dependency closure is checked…
- [DOpus](https://mixos.dev/dopus.md): DOpus is the native two-pane Wayland file manager. Navigation, selection, sorting, file-operation dialogs and drag and drop use the shared toolkit. It requires…
- [Edit service](https://mixos.dev/edit.md): editd registers the edit service and serves the edit.v1 contract. Ced and agents share its buffers through native ABP. The service is headless and requires no…
- [Mix](https://mixos.dev/mix.md): Mix is the MixOS shell and scripting language. The interpreter lives in the mix library; cli/mix-shell owns the binary, interactive shell and native ABP…
- [Native isolated session](https://mixos.dev/native-session.md): The initial native session profile builds compd with backend-all and without desktop-dbus. ABP/noded carries application requests, discovery, session grants…
- [Native node broker](https://mixos.dev/noded.md): noded is MixOS's ABP broker. Services register with it, discover other services and exchange commands or topic events. Communication between nodes uses ABP…
- [Scene Editor](https://mixos.dev/scene-editor.md): Scene Editor is a normal native Wayland app, using the same application host and widgets as Ced. It has File, Edit, Scene, Arrange, View and Help menus. The…
- [app.describe — the shared application discovery contract](https://mixos.dev/spec/application/describe-v1.md): Status: accepted, contract version 0.1.0, marker application.describe.v1. Implemented in libs/application/src/describe.rs behind the opt-in describe feature…
- [Native hardware observations](https://mixos.dev/spec/compd/native-hardware.md): Status: accepted additive contract, compd 0.1.18. ABP wire unchanged.
- [Native desktop worlds (compd 0.1.17)](https://mixos.dev/spec/compd/native-worlds.md): These strict additive Bus verbs use the existing bounded engine control lane. They create actual native spatial worlds, independent from virtual workspaces.
- [Live output scale — compd 0.1.20](https://mixos.dev/spec/compd/output-scale.md): comp.output.scale {output, instance, generation, scale} is a finite native ABP request. Read the exact name, allocation UUID and positive topology generation…
- [Native window tiling — compd 0.1.16](https://mixos.dev/spec/compd/window-tiling.md): comp.window.tile requires unsigned id and generation, and accepts an optional output key or native name. comp.window.untile accepts only the same required…
- [Desktop settings contract](https://mixos.dev/spec/settings/README.md): Status: accepted initial authority contract, version 0.1.1. Full desktop consumer integration remains in development. No frozen ABP wire bytes change.
- [Term](https://mixos.dev/term.md): Term is the native Wayland terminal. Its toolkit-free core owns PTYs, the VT model and native session control; the graphical app uses the shared toolkit and…
